zh.title: 美國解除墨西哥航空新航線限制 墨西哥城航線可再申請
zh.summary: 美國運輸部解除限制；墨西哥航空可再申請墨西哥城新美國航線，仍受監督
body: 美國運輸部解除對墨西哥航空業者的限制，墨西哥的航空公司自墨西哥城申請新美國航線的管道重新開放。
根據 Simple Flying 報導，這項鬆綁發生在美國封鎖13條墨西哥城航線的一年之後。
報導指出，墨西哥的航空公司可再次申請自墨西哥城出發的新美國航線，但仍在美國運輸部持續監督之下。
目前已知的資訊僅限於主管機關解除限制與航線申請管道重啟，其他營運細節尚未公佈。

en.title: US lifts restrictions on Mexican airlines, reopening Mexico City route applications
en.summary: DOT drops limits; Mexican carriers may again apply for new US routes from Mexico City under continued oversight
body: The United States has dropped restrictions on Mexican airlines, reopening the way for Mexico's carriers to apply for new US routes from Mexico City, according to Simple Flying.
The move comes a year after the US blocked 13 Mexico City routes, the report said.
Mexico's airlines can apply for new US routes from Mexico City again, but under continued DOT oversight, according to the report.
The available information covers the lifting of the restrictions and the reopening of the route application channel; further operational details were not disclosed.
